couplets.en: The mirror asks me for the face I used to wear.

lines: Aaina mujhse meri pehli si surat maange

couplets.en: The mirror asks for my old face, and my own ask for some proof that I exist.

lines: Main bhatakta hi raha dard ke veeraane mein
Waqt likhta raha chehre pe har pal ka hisaab
couplets.en: I wandered through the wasteland of pain as time kept count of every moment on my face.

lines: Meri shohrat meri deewangi ki nazr hui
Pee gayi mai ki botal mere geeton ki kitaab
couplets.en: My madness took my good name, and the bottle drank up my book of songs.

lines: Aaj lauta hoon to hansne ki ada bhool gaya
Yeh shehar bhoola mujhe, main bhi ise bhool gaya
couplets.en: I come back today having forgotten how to laugh, to a city that forgot me as I forgot it.

lines: Mere apne mere hone ki nishani maangein
Aaina mujhse meri pehli si surat maange
couplets.en: My own ask for some proof that I exist, and the mirror asks for my old face.

lines: Mera fan phir mujhe bazaar mein le aaya hai
couplets.en: My art has brought me back to the marketplace.

lines: Yeh woh jaa hai ke jahaan mehr-o-wafa bikte hain
couplets.en: This is where affection and fidelity are sold.

lines: Baap bikte hain aur lakht-e-jigar bikte hain
Kokh bikti hai, dil bikte hain, sar bikte hain
couplets.en: Fathers and their own flesh and blood are sold, and so are wombs, hearts and heads.

lines: Is badalti hui duniya ka Khuda koi nahin
Saste daamon mein har roz Khuda bikte hain
couplets.en: This changing world has no God, and every day gods are sold for a pittance.

lines: Mere apne mere hone ki nishani maangein
Aaina mujhse meri pehli si surat maange
couplets.en: My own ask for some proof that I exist, and the mirror asks for my old face.

lines: Mere ehsaas, mere phool, kahin aur chalein
Bol Pooja, meri bachchi, kahin aur chalein
couplets.en: Tell me, Pooja, my child, my flower, shall we go somewhere else?

lines: Aur chalein
